name: invented7
idea: The traces show 84-89% of accesses repeat a (previous_delta, current_delta) pair per PC, a two-step history signal that a one-step stride predictor structurally cannot use; by maintaining a compact per-PC history of the last two line-deltas and prefetching the delta observed once before the same (prev,cur) pair, this catches the long-stride (>8 line) and irregular traversals the current stack miss
